name: MonarchProgress
title: Progress
summary: A progress indicator as a bar or a ring, determinate or indeterminate.
whenToUse: While the app works on something for more than about a second, and for quotas and completion.
whenNotToUse: For the loading state of a button use the loading parameter of MonarchButton.
api: @Composable fun MonarchProgress(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, progress: Float? = null, variant: MonarchProgressVariant = MonarchProgressVariant.Linear, label: String? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Accent, size: MonarchProgressSize = MonarchProgressSize.Md, showValue: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchProgressSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: progress
options.description: The completed fraction from 0 to 1; null when the duration is unknown. Clamped.

options.name: label
options.description: What is in progress, for TalkBack. Indeterminate without a label is named "Loading" (monarch_progress_loading).

options.name: tone
options.description: The color of the indicator: the accent, or a status tone for quotas and checks. Keep the meaning in text too.

options.name: size
options.description: The bar thickness (4, 8, 12dp) or ring diameter (24, 40, 64dp).

options.name: showValue
options.description: Writes the percentage after the bar or small ring, inside a large ring. Determinate only; read once, from the indicator.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: The indicator animates without a value.

appearance: The indicator is the tone's solid color (the accent by default; neutral uses the strong border) and the track the emphasis background, in every theme.
platformNotes: One component covers the web's Progress and Spinner and iOS's MonarchProgressViewStyle. The Material 3 gap and stop indicator of the linear bar are kept. Stacked segments are not offered yet.
accessibility: Exposes the progress range, so TalkBack reads the percentage of a determinate indicator.
An indeterminate indicator is named Loading unless a label is given.
The label says what is in progress.
The animation follows the system animator duration scale.
edgeCases: A value below 0 or above 1 is clamped.
With animations removed in the system settings an indeterminate indicator does not move.

examples.title: Determinate and indeterminate
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = {{bars.0.value}} / 100f,
        label = {{bars.0.label}},
        tone = {{bars.0.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{bars.0.size|pascal}},
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = {{bars.1.value}} / 100f,
        label = {{bars.1.label}},
        tone = {{bars.1.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{bars.1.size|pascal}},
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = null,
        label = {{bars.2.label}},
        tone = {{bars.2.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{bars.2.size|pascal}},
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = 40 / 100f,
        label = "Upload progress",
        tone = MonarchTone.Accent,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Md,
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = 100 / 100f,
        label = "Import progress",
        tone = MonarchTone.Success,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Sm,
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = null,
        label = "Syncing members",
        tone = MonarchTone.Accent,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Md,
    )
}
